name: @pipeworx/mcp-bundesbank-de

tools.name: list_dataflows
tools.description: List the available Bundesbank statistics dataflows (each is a series collection you can query with get_series). Returns SDMX 2.1 structure XML listing every dataflow id + name under agency BBK. Well-known flows: BBEX3 (exchange rates), BBK01 (legacy single time series), BBSIS (interest rates), BBBK1/BBBK2 (banking statistics), BBDB1 (balance of payments). Pass a flowRef to fetch just that one dataflow (includes its DataStructure reference).

flowRef.description: Optional. A single dataflow id (e.g. "BBEX3") to fetch instead of the full list.

tools.name: dataflow_structure
tools.description: Get the data structure definition (DSD) for a dataflow: its dimensions and the valid codes for each, which you need to build a series key for get_series. Returns SDMX 2.1 structure XML. The DSD id differs from the dataflow id (e.g. dataflow BBEX3 uses DSD "BBK_ERX"). Pass the dataflow id (flowRef) and this tool resolves the DSD for you; the dimensions appear in <DimensionList> in key order. Set withCodes=true (default) to inline the codelists (references=children).

flowRef.description: Dataflow id whose structure you want, e.g. "BBEX3".

withCodes.description: Include the referenced codelists (valid dimension values). Default true.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: Pull observations for a Bundesbank series as SDMX-JSON. flowRef is the dataflow id (e.g. "BBEX3"); key is a dot-separated SDMX dimension filter in key order (e.g. "D.USD.EUR.BB.AC.000" = daily USD/EUR reference rate). Use dataflow_structure to discover the dimensions/codes for a flow. Leave a dimension empty to wildcard it (e.g. "D..EUR.BB.AC.000"). Filter by lastNObservations (most recent N) or a startPeriod/endPeriod date range (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

key.description: Dot-separated SDMX dimension filter, e.g. "D.USD.EUR.BB.AC.000". Empty segments wildcard a dimension.

lastNObservations.description: Return only the most recent N observations.

startPeriod.description: Inclusive start period (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

endPeriod.description: Inclusive end period (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bundesbank-de forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bundesbank-de pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
